ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review (SAFE-1): the driver's 09:54:05 chat message is an intimidation/threat ("Hurry up or I will find you and you will regret it."). Preserve the chat log and GPS trace; consider immediate account suspension of the driver pending review, and contact the rider to confirm safety. The $6.61 no-show fee decision is to be made by the human reviewer, not automatically.
ruling.escalation_reason: SAFE-1: credible intimidation/threat by the driver in the in-app chat ("Hurry up or I will find you and you will regret it.") immediately before a driver-initiated cancellation. Automatic adjudication is barred; the case goes to a human reviewer with this summary.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver claims he "waited more than 4 minutes"; the system record shows arrival/here-press at 09:50:45 and cancellation at 09:54:25 with the GPS trace only supporting roughly 3–3.5 minutes at the pickup point, so the statement conflicts with the record and does not establish NS-1(iii).
No off-route segment facts (gps-detour-*) were computed given the trip was cancelled before pickup; RD group is not engaged.
